read.en: Applied Materials fell 8.2% on Oct 22 to $375.58, trading between $375.20 and $389.82 on volume twice its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($402.4), 10-day ($435.7), 30-day ($466.3) and 100-day ($514.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($441.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($469.28), and RSI is 25.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月22日下跌 8.2%，收于 $375.58，盘中区间 $375.20–389.82，成交量约为 20 日均量的两倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$402.4）、10 日（$435.7）、30 日（$466.3）和 100 日均线（$514.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$441.5）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$469.28），RSI 为 25。

read.en: The drop broke $407.3 and $397 and closed just under the $377–380 April lows, now resistance. Resistance is $377–380, then $397–402 (May 19 low, 5-day average) and $407–414 (Oct 16 low, Oct 21 high). Support is $375.2 (Oct 22 low), then $350 and $320.7 (Mar 30 low). A close back above $380 would target $397–402; a close below $375 would open $350.
